title: Diffusion-based Surrogate Model for Time-varying Underwater Acoustic Channels
abstract: arXiv:2511.18078v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate modeling of time-varying underwater acoustic channels is essential for the design, evaluation, and deployment of reliable underwater communication systems. Conventional physics models require detailed environmental knowledge, while stochastic replay methods are constrained by the limited diversity of measured channels and often fail to generalize to unseen scenarios, reducing their practical applicability. To address these challenges, we propose StableUASim, a pre-trained conditional latent diffusion surrogate model that captures the stochastic dynamics of underwater acoustic communication channels. Leveraging generative modeling, StableUASim produces diverse and statistically realistic channel realizations, while supporting conditional generation from specific measurement samples. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的时变水声信道代理模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.18078v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：对时变水声信道进行准确建模，对于可靠水声通信系统的设计、评估和部署至关重要。传统物理模型需要详细的环境知识，而随机回放方法受限于实测信道的有限多样性，往往难以泛化到未见过的场景，降低了其实际适用性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了StableUASim，一个预训练的条件潜在扩散代理模型，用于捕捉水声通信信道的随机动态特性。借助生成式建模，StableUASim能够生成多样化且统计上逼真的信道实现，同时支持基于特定测量样本的条件生成。预训练使模型能够利用极少的额外数据快速适应新环境，自编码器的潜在表征有助于……
tldr: 提出StableUASim——一种预训练的条件潜在扩散代理模型，能够生成多样化且统计逼真的时变水声信道实现，支持条件生成，并可利用极少量数据快速适应新环境。
en_tdlr: StableUASim, a pre-trained conditional latent diffusion surrogate model, generates diverse and statistically realistic time-varying underwater acoustic channel realizations, supports conditional generation from measurement samples, and rapidly adapts to new environments with minimal additional data.
